items.exampleEn: Ironically, the speaker on time management arrived late.
items.exampleZh: 諷刺的是，那位講時間管理的講者遲到了。

items.exampleEn: Please specify the size and color you want.
items.exampleZh: 請具體寫明你要的尺寸和顏色。

items.exampleEn: It's a stereotype that all engineers are shy.
items.exampleZh: 說工程師都很害羞，是一種刻板印象。

items.exampleEn: After many rejections, she finally found a job.

items.exampleEn: There is growing optimism about the economy.
items.exampleZh: 大家對經濟越來越樂觀。

items.exampleEn: His obsession with his phone worries his parents.
items.exampleZh: 他對手機的著迷讓爸媽很擔心。

items.exampleEn: Her sudden realization of the danger saved the whole family.
items.exampleZh: 她突然意識到危險，救了全家人。

items.exampleEn: He is a thoughtful manager who always listens to his staff.
items.exampleZh: 他是一位體貼的經理，總是傾聽員工的意見。

items.sentenceEn: The contract does not specify who will pay for repairs.
items.sentenceZh: 合約沒有明確說明修理費由誰支付。

items.audioZh: 諷刺的是，那家咖啡店開幕當天咖啡就賣完了。
items.questionZh: 開幕當天發生了什麼事？
options: The shop opened two hours late
The shop had no coffee left

items.sentenceEn: Her optimism helped the team through a difficult year.
items.sentenceZh: 她的樂觀幫助團隊度過艱難的一年。

items.sentenceEn: Don't let one rejection stop you from trying again.
items.sentenceZh: 別因為被拒絕一次就不再嘗試。

items.stemEn: Not all Italians love pizza; that's just a ____.
items.stemZh: 不是所有義大利人都愛披薩；那只是一種刻板印象。

items.stemEn: It was very ____ of you to remember my birthday.
items.stemZh: 你記得我的生日，真的很貼心。

items.passageEn: When Leo started his first company, he received rejection after rejection from banks. People told him it was only a stereotype that young business owners always fail, but he still felt the banks' doubts. His friends admired his optimism, although some thought his work had become an obsession. One day, he had an important realization: his product was good, but he had never clearly specified who it was for. He gave his plan a thoughtful rewrite, focusing on small cafes. Ironically, the bank that had first said no became his biggest supporter.
items.passageZh: Leo 剛創辦第一家公司時，一次又一次被銀行拒絕。大家告訴他，「年輕老闆一定會失敗」只是刻板印象，但他還是感受到銀行的懷疑。朋友們佩服他的樂觀，不過也有人覺得他對工作已經到了著迷的地步。有一天，他領悟到一件重要的事：他的產品很好，但他從來沒有明確說明產品是給誰用的。他用心地重寫了計畫，把目標放在小咖啡店上。諷刺的是，當初第一個拒絕他的銀行，後來成了他最大的支持者。

options: 沒說清楚產品是給誰用的
產品的品質其實不夠好

questions.questionZh: 這個故事最諷刺的地方是什麼？
options: 他最好的朋友開了一樣的公司
最早拒絕他的銀行最支持他
附近小咖啡店都不喜歡他的產品
他最後自己跑去那家銀行上班

items.promptZh: 到了機場，我才意識到我忘了帶護照。
referenceEn: At the airport, I came to the realization that I had forgotten my passport.
My realization that I had left my passport at home came at the airport.
rubricZh: realization 是名詞（例如 come to the realization that…、the realization that… 等）
寫 I realized… 意思也對；「忘了帶」用過去完成式較好，過去式也可以

items.promptZh: 我弟弟對恐龍非常著迷。
referenceEn: My younger brother has an obsession with dinosaurs.
My little brother has a real obsession with dinosaurs.
rubricZh: obsession 常用 have an obsession with…（例如 has an obsession with dinosaurs 等）
「弟弟」可寫，例如 younger brother、little brother 等
